author: National Geographic
description:
The health of the land begins with the soil. Matthieu Paley, National Geographic photographer, visits Waitrose Farm to better understand how soil is a living organism, and why giving it time to recover is critical. Through good stewardship of their land, farmers are working to protect the future of food.
